messages.text: Littler's bid for historic PDC majors sweep suffers blow

metadata.summary: Luke Littler's bid to qualify for the Players Championship Finals, and keep alive his hopes of claiming a historic clean sweep of PDC major titles in 2026, suffered a blow with a quarter-final exit at PC27.
metadata.content: Luke Littler suffers Players Championship 27 quarter-final exit with loss to eventual winner Jermaine Wattimena | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to content Luke Littler suffers Players Championship 27 quarter-final exit with loss to eventual winner Jermaine Wattimena Luke Littler has won every major on PDC circuit so far in 2026 in bid for historic clean sweep; world No 1 must finish in top 64 of Players Championship Order of Merit in order to qualify for Finals in November; 19-year-old lost 6-5 to eventual PC27 winner Jermaine Wattimena in last eight Tuesday 25 August 2026 20:17, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player James Wattimena hit a 115 checkout to claim his first victory over Luke Littler in the Players Championship 27 quarter-finals (Credit: PDC) Luke Littler's bid to qualify for the Players Championship Finals, and keep alive his hopes of claiming a historic clean sweep of PDC major titles in 2026, suffered a blow with a quarter-final exit at PC27. Littler was beaten 6-5 by Jermaine Wattimena in a final-leg decider, with the Dutchman going on to take the title in Leicester, overcoming countryman Kevin Doets 8-6 in the final. Littler beat Archie Self 6-2, Arno Merk 6-3 and then William O'Connor 6-3 to set up a last-16 tie with Chris Dobey, who he thrashed 6-0, before losing out to eventual champion Wattimena. metadata.summary: Manchester United have completed the signing of midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton.
metadata.content: Carlos Baleba transfer: Manchester United complete signing of Cameroon midfielder from Brighton | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Carlos Baleba transfer: Manchester United complete signing of Cameroon midfielder from Brighton Sky Sports News has been reporting on United's interest in Baleba since last autumn and broke the news that they enquired about signing him during the January transfer window; the Cameroon international signs a five-year deal at Old Trafford Tuesday 25 August 2026 19:02, UK Image: Carlos Baleba has joined Manchester United from Brighton Manchester United have completed the signing of midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton. The Cameroon international, 22, joins the club in a deal worth up to £70m, made up of a £65m guaranteed fee plus £5m in add-ons. He has signed a five-year contract which includes the option of a further year. Baleba is currently injured, having picked up an ankle injury in pre-season, but Sky Sports News understands he could be back by mid-September.
